summary: Applied the retention lens to Fund II LPs, who are meant to provide 60% of Fund III. Agreed a re-up target, partner meetings for the top 8 LPs and a 30-day onboarding pack for new LPs. Asking LPs to increase tickets is pending and an annual LP survey was declined.

discussion.keyPoints: Natalie flagged 3 Fund II LPs at risk of not re-upping because of allocation changes on their side.
The top 8 LPs make up most of Fund II. Richard sees some of them only at the annual meeting.
Richard wants Fund II LPs to increase their tickets. Natalie thought it should depend on each LP's allocation.

recommendations.recommendation: Target a 75% re-up rate by commitment value from Fund II LPs, with a named plan for each of the 3 at-risk LPs.
Richard to meet each of the top 8 LPs by commitment twice a year.
Send new LPs an onboarding pack within 30 days of close with a named IR contact.
Ask Fund II LPs to increase their Fund III ticket by 25% on average.
Run an annual LP satisfaction survey.

actions.action: Write retention plans for the 3 at-risk LPs

nextFocus: Model the economics of the raise and Fund III fees.
nextPreparation: Bring the fundraising budget and the draft Fund III LPA terms.

tests.question: What re-up rate are we targeting?
How often will Richard meet the top LPs?
Is the 25% ticket increase ask agreed?
